paper_title: DeltaEdit Enhancing Sequential Editing in Large Language Models by   Controlling Superimposed Noise
caption: The variation curve of k^⊤β for AlphaEdit and MEMIT as the number of edits increases, with GPT2-XL serving as the edited model. As the results of Llama3-8B are not suitable for display in a line chart, they are presented in Appendix <ref>.

model_annotations.English: The line plot, titled "GPT2-XL," illustrates the values of $k^\top\beta$ for AlphaEdit and MEMIT. The x-axis is unlabeled, operates on a linear scale, and spans from an initial data point near 250 to an end point of 3000, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 500 starting at 500. The y-axis is labeled "$k^\top\beta$" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0.002 to 0.012 at regular intervals of 0.002, and no units are provided. The line for "AlphaEdit $k^\top\beta$" is a solid light red line with circular markers; it begins at a y-value of exactly 0.004 at the initial x-axis point near 250 and shows a steady decline across the plot, ending at a low of approximately 0.001 at an x-value of 3000. The line for "MEMIT $k^\top\beta$" is a solid light blue line with circular markers; it starts at a y-value of approximately 0.0045 at the first x-axis point and exhibits a continuous steady increase, reaching its peak value of approximately 0.0128 at an x-value of 3000.
model_annotations.German: This plot, titled "GPT2-XL," illustrates the variation of $k^\top \beta$ values for AlphaEdit and MEMIT. The x-axis is unlabelled and is displayed on a linear scale with numeric tick marks starting at 500 and ending at 3000, spaced at regular intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled "$k^\top \beta$" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0.002 to 0.012 at regular intervals of 0.002. The plot contains two lines. The line representing "AlphaEdit $k^\top \beta$" is solid light red with circular markers; it begins at an estimated x-value of roughly 250 with a y-value of approximately 0.004, declines to approximately 0.0025 at x=500, and then gradually and steadily decreases to finish at roughly 0.001 at x=3000. The line representing "MEMIT $k^\top \beta$" is solid light blue with circular markers; it starts at an estimated x-value of 250 with a y-value of roughly 0.0045 and increases steadily across the entirety of the x-axis, reaching a final value of approximately 0.0128 at x=3000.
